title: Dan državnosti: kako je BiH 1943. vratila svoju državnost
Statehood Day: how BiH regained its statehood in 1943
body: Bosna i Hercegovina danas, 25. novembra, obilježava Dan državnosti.
Today, 25 November, Bosnia and Herzegovina marks Statehood Day.
Praznik podsjeća na prvo zasjedanje ZAVNOBiH-a, koje je održano 25. i 26. novembra 1943. u Mrkonjić Gradu.
The holiday recalls the first session of ZAVNOBiH, which was held on 25 and 26 November 1943 in Mrkonjić Grad.
Tada je trajao Drugi svjetski rat, a BiH je bila dio takozvane Nezavisne Države Hrvatske.
The Second World War was going on at the time, and BiH was part of the so-called Independent State of Croatia.
Na sjednici je bilo 247 delegata iz cijele zemlje, a njih 193 imalo je pravo glasa.
There were 247 delegates from all over the country at the session, and 193 of them had the right to vote.
Oni su predstavljali sve narode, vjere i različite političke stavove.
They represented all peoples, religions and different political views.
U rezoluciji su napisali da BiH nije ni srpska, ni hrvatska, ni muslimanska, nego i srpska, i muslimanska, i hrvatska.
In the resolution they wrote that BiH is neither Serb, nor Croat, nor Muslim, but Serb, and Muslim, and Croat.
Delegati su izabrali 173 vijećnika, a za predsjednika je izabran ljekar Vojislav Kecmanović iz Bijeljine.
The delegates elected 173 councillors, and the doctor Vojislav Kecmanović from Bijeljina was elected president.
Tako je BiH dobila svoju državnost prvi put nakon pada srednjovjekovnog kraljevstva 1463. godine.
In this way BiH got its statehood for the first time since the fall of the medieval kingdom in 1463.
Granice koje su tada potvrđene postale su 1992. međunarodno priznate granice nezavisne države.
The borders that were confirmed then became the internationally recognised borders of the independent state in 1992.
Dan državnosti je neradni dan u Federaciji BiH, ali u Republici Srpskoj se taj dan radi.
Statehood Day is a non-working day in the Federation of BiH, but in Republika Srpska people work on that day.
Klix.ba piše da poruka iz Mrkonjić Grada i danas vrijedi: ova zemlja jednako pripada svim narodima i građanima.
Klix.ba writes that the message from Mrkonjić Grad is still valid today: this country belongs equally to all peoples and citizens.

title: Huti dronom pogodili najviši toranj u Rijadu, 11 ranjenih
Houthis hit the tallest tower in Riyadh with a drone, 11 injured
body: Jemenska grupa Huti napala je dronom jedan toranj u finansijskom dijelu Rijada.
The Yemeni group the Houthis attacked a tower in the financial district of Riyadh with a drone.
U napadu je ranjeno 11 ljudi, a to je drugi napad na isti dio saudijskog glavnog grada za manje od sedmicu.
Eleven people were injured in the attack, and it is the second attack on the same part of the Saudi capital in less than a week.
Saudijska civilna zaštita objavila je da su među ranjenima dva Saudijca i devet stranaca.
Saudi civil defence announced that among the injured are two Saudis and nine foreigners.
Ranjeni su četiri Egipćanina, tri državljanina Nepala i dva Indijca.
The injured are four Egyptians, three citizens of Nepal and two Indians.
Prema izvoru agencije AFP, najmanje dvije osobe imaju teške opekotine i u kritičnom su stanju.
According to a source of the AFP agency, at least two people have serious burns and are in critical condition.
Vlasti nisu rekle koja je zgrada pogođena, ali AFP piše da je riječ o tornju državnog fonda PIF.
The authorities did not say which building was hit, but AFP writes that it is the tower of the state fund PIF.
Toranj ima 80 spratova i visok je oko 385 metara.
The tower has 80 floors and is about 385 metres tall.
U zgradi su u trenutku napada bili radnici koji su popravljali štetu od prošlog napada.
At the moment of the attack there were workers in the building who were repairing the damage from the previous attack.
Civilna zaštita je napad nazvala terorističkim i rekla je da su hitne službe odmah stigle na mjesto.
Civil defence called the attack terrorist and said that emergency services arrived at the site immediately.
Turki al-Maliki, glasnogovornik koalicije koju vodi Saudijska Arabija, rekao je da će odgovor biti odlučan.
Turki al-Maliki, the spokesman of the coalition led by Saudi Arabia, said that the response would be firm.
Dodao je da napadi na civile i civilne objekte neće proći bez odgovora.
He added that attacks on civilians and civilian facilities will not go unanswered.

title: Garza bez promašaja u pobjedi Bostona, Jokić izgubio
Garza without a miss in Boston win, Jokić lost
body: Boston Celticsi pobijedili su Washington Wizardse sa 131:116 u NBA Kupu.
The Boston Celtics beat the Washington Wizards 131:116 in the NBA Cup.
Bosanskohercegovački košarkaš Luka Garza ubacio je sva tri šuta, uključujući jednu trojku.
Bosnian-Herzegovinian basketball player Luka Garza made all three shots, including one three-pointer.
Za 18 minuta u igri imao je 7 poena, 4 skoka i jednu ukradenu loptu.
In 18 minutes of play he had 7 points, 4 rebounds and one steal.
Sve poene Garza je dao u drugoj četvrtini, kada je Boston preuzeo kontrolu nad utakmicom.
Garza scored all his points in the second quarter, when Boston took control of the game.
Boston je tu četvrtinu dobio sa 46:21, a na poluvremenu je vodio sa 80:49.
Boston won that quarter 46:21, and at half-time it led 80:49.
Najbolji strijelac bio je Jayson Tatum s 41 poenom, što je njegov najbolji rezultat ove sezone.
The top scorer was Jayson Tatum with 41 points, which is his best result this season.
Washington je u zadnjoj četvrtini smanjio razliku na pet poena, ali Boston je ipak pobijedio.
Washington cut the gap to five points in the last quarter, but Boston still won.
U drugoj utakmici Dallas je u gostima pobijedio Denver sa 120:101.
In another game, Dallas beat Denver away 120:101.
Nikola Jokić imao je 18 poena i 11 skokova, ali i pet izgubljenih lopti.
Nikola Jokić had 18 points and 11 rebounds, but also five turnovers.
Za Dallas je mladi Cooper Flagg dao 24 poena i imao 12 asistencija.
For Dallas, young Cooper Flagg scored 24 points and had 12 assists.
Boston u petak igra protiv Atlante, a pobjednik te utakmice bit će prvi u grupi.
On Friday Boston plays against Atlanta, and the winner of that game will be first in the group.

title: Nizozemski mediji dali Bajraktareviću najnižu ocjenu nakon poraza
Dutch media gave Bajraktarević the lowest rating after the defeat
body: Esmir Bajraktarević dobio je najnižu ocjenu u timu PSV-a nakon teškog poraza u Madridu.
Esmir Bajraktarević got the lowest rating in the PSV team after a heavy defeat in Madrid.
Real Madrid je u utorak u Ligi prvaka pobijedio PSV sa 5:1 na stadionu Santiago Bernabéu.
On Tuesday in the Champions League, Real Madrid beat PSV 5:1 at the Santiago Bernabéu stadium.
Nizozemski magazin Voetbal International dao mu je ocjenu 5, a za prolaz je potrebna ocjena 6.
The Dutch magazine Voetbal International gave him a 5, and a 6 is needed for a pass.
On je bio jedini igrač PSV-a s ocjenom ispod prolazne.
He was the only PSV player with a rating below a pass.
Najbolju ocjenu, 7, dobio je Ivan Perišić.
The best rating, 7, went to Ivan Perišić.
Druga dva portala bila su blaža i dala su Bajraktareviću ocjenu 5,5.
Two other portals were milder and gave Bajraktarević a 5.5.
Novinar magazina VI napisao je da krilni igrač nije pokazao ništa posebno i da je uglavnom trčao nazad u odbranu.
A journalist of VI magazine wrote that the winger showed nothing special and mostly ran back into defence.
Bajraktarević je počeo na klupi, a trener Peter Bosz uveo ga je na poluvremenu umjesto Perišića.
Bajraktarević started on the bench, and coach Peter Bosz brought him on at half-time instead of Perišić.
Prema televiziji NOS, to nije bila taktička izmjena, jer se Perišić nije dobro osjećao.
According to the broadcaster NOS, it was not a tactical substitution, because Perišić did not feel well.
PSV je na poluvremenu vodio sa 1:0, ali je Real u drugom dijelu dao pet golova.
PSV led 1:0 at half-time, but Real scored five goals in the second half.
PSV sada ima četiri boda nakon pet utakmica, a 9. decembra igra protiv Atlética.
PSV now has four points after five matches, and on 9 December it plays against Atlético.

title: Porota u SAD-u proglasila Huawei krivim za krađu i sankcije
US jury finds Huawei guilty of theft and sanctions violations
body: Porota u Brooklynu u New Yorku proglasila je kinesku kompaniju Huawei krivom po 10 od 12 tačaka optužnice.
A jury in Brooklyn, New York, found the Chinese company Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts of the indictment.
Suđenje je trajalo tri mjeseca, a presudu je objavilo američko Ministarstvo pravde.
The trial lasted three months, and the verdict was announced by the US Department of Justice.
Kompanija je oslobođena za najteže djelo, udruživanje radi reketiranja, i za ometanje pravde.
The company was acquitted of the most serious offence, racketeering conspiracy, and of obstruction of justice.
Huawei je kriv za kršenje sankcija Iranu, laganje bankama, pranje novca i krađu poslovnih tajni.
Huawei is guilty of violating sanctions on Iran, lying to banks, money laundering and stealing trade secrets.
Tužioci kažu da je kompanija u Iranu gradila mreže i pomagala vladi da prati i cenzuriše internet.
Prosecutors say that the company built networks in Iran and helped the government monitor and censor the internet.
Od kompanije T-Mobile navodno je uzela podatke o robotu za testiranje ekrana, a od Cisca kod za rutere.
From the company T-Mobile it allegedly took data about a robot for testing screens, and from Cisco code for routers.
Kazna će biti određena 14. septembra 2027., a prema agenciji AP mogla bi iznositi milijarde dolara.
The penalty will be set on 14 September 2027, and according to the AP agency it could amount to billions of dollars.
Advokat kompanije Brian Heberlig rekao je da će Huawei uložiti žalbu.
The company's lawyer Brian Heberlig said that Huawei would appeal.
Huawei tvrdi da nijedan sud nikada nije utvrdio da je namjerno uzeo tuđe intelektualno vlasništvo.
Huawei claims that no court has ever found that it intentionally took other people's intellectual property.
Optužnica je podignuta još 2019. godine, a Huawei godinama ne smije prodavati opremu američkim mobilnim operaterima.
The indictment was filed back in 2019, and for years Huawei has not been allowed to sell equipment to US mobile operators.

title: Jennifer Barreto iz Portorika nova je Miss Universe
Jennifer Barreto from Puerto Rico is the new Miss Universe
body: Jennifer Barreto iz Portorika pobijedila je na 75. izboru za Miss Universe.
Jennifer Barreto from Puerto Rico won the 75th Miss Universe pageant.
Finale je održano 24. novembra u glavnom gradu Portorika, San Juanu.
The final was held on 24 November in the capital of Puerto Rico, San Juan.
Takmičilo se 116 djevojaka iz različitih zemalja i teritorija.
116 young women from different countries and territories competed.
Krunu joj je stavila prošlogodišnja pobjednica Fátima Bosch iz Meksika.
The crown was placed on her by last year's winner Fátima Bosch from Mexico.
Ovo je šesta titula za Portoriko i prva nakon 20 godina, jer je posljednja pobijedila Zuleyka Rivera 2006. godine.
This is the sixth title for Puerto Rico and the first after 20 years, because the last to win was Zuleyka Rivera in 2006.
Drugo mjesto zauzela je Melissa Núñez iz Dominikanske Republike, a treće Clara Vegas iz Venecuele.
Second place went to Melissa Núñez from the Dominican Republic, and third to Clara Vegas from Venezuela.
Među pet najboljih bile su i takmičarke s Filipina i iz Novog Zelanda.
Among the top five there were also contestants from the Philippines and New Zealand.
Nova Miss Universe ima 27 godina i završila je psihologiju i socijalni rad.
The new Miss Universe is 27 years old and has a degree in psychology and social work.
Radila je na sprečavanju nasilja u porodici, zaštiti djece i pomoći porodicama.
She has worked on preventing domestic violence, protecting children and helping families.
Magazin People piše da je ona prva majka koja je osvojila ovu titulu.
People magazine writes that she is the first mother to win this title.
Barreto ima kćerku koja se zove Penelope.
Barreto has a daughter called Penelope.

title: Jakov Jozinović održao koncert u rasprodanoj Skenderiji
Jakov Jozinović held a concert in a sold-out Skenderija
body: Hrvatski pjevač Jakov Jozinović održao je koncert u rasprodanoj dvorani Skenderija u Sarajevu.
Croatian singer Jakov Jozinović held a concert in the sold-out Skenderija hall in Sarajevo.
Gošća večeri bila je Džejla Ramović, s kojom je prvi put uživo izveo duet "Suze".
The guest of the evening was Džejla Ramović, with whom he performed the duet "Suze" live for the first time.
Pjesmu su objavili 20. novembra.
They released the song on 20 November.
Jozinović je rekao publici da nešto ovako nikada nije vidio.
Jozinović told the audience that he had never seen anything like this.
Pjevao je svoje pjesme "Polje ruža" i "Ja volim", ali i poznate pjesme iz regiona.
He sang his songs "Polje ruža" and "Ja volim", but also well-known songs from the region.
Izveo je, između ostalog, pjesme Kemala Montena, Dine Merlina, Olivera Dragojevića i Halida Bešlića.
Among other things, he performed songs by Kemal Monteno, Dino Merlin, Oliver Dragojević and Halid Bešlić.
Na scenu je pozvao osmogodišnju Asju iz Travnika, koja je kao najdražu pjesmu odmah izabrala "Polje ruža".
He invited eight-year-old Asja from Travnik onto the stage, who immediately chose "Polje ruža" as her favourite song.
Tokom dueta je kleknuo pred Džejlu i aplaudirao joj, a nastup su završili zagrljajem.
During the duet he knelt before Džejla and applauded her, and they ended the performance with a hug.
Djevojke iz prvih redova bacale su mu plišane igračke i pjevale s njim.
Girls from the front rows threw plush toys at him and sang with him.
Jozinović je brzo postao jedno od najtraženijih imena u regionu, a dvorane je punio i prije prve vlastite pjesme.
Jozinović quickly became one of the most sought-after names in the region, and he filled halls even before his first original song.
Koncert u Sarajevu dio je njegove regionalne turneje "Ja za čuda letim".
The concert in Sarajevo is part of his regional tour "Ja za čuda letim".

title: Ljudi s više vitamina D spavaju duže, pokazuje studija
People with more vitamin D sleep longer, a study shows
body: Američki naučnici otkrili su da stariji ljudi s višim nivoom vitamina D duže spavaju.
American scientists have found that older people with a higher level of vitamin D sleep longer.
Istraživanje su uradili stručnjaci s Univerziteta Johns Hopkins i američkog Nacionalnog instituta za starenje.
The research was done by experts from Johns Hopkins University and the US National Institute on Aging.
Pratili su 460 muškaraca i žena, koji su u prosjeku imali oko 71 godinu.
They followed 460 men and women, who were on average about 71 years old.
Vitamin D mjerili su iz krvi, a san uređajem koji se nosi na ruci i bilježi pokrete.
They measured vitamin D from the blood, and sleep with a device that is worn on the wrist and records movements.
Ljudi s najviše vitamina D spavali su u prosjeku skoro 20 minuta duže od onih s najmanje.
People with the most vitamin D slept on average almost 20 minutes longer than those with the least.
Oni su se tokom noći i kraće budili.
They also woke up for shorter periods during the night.
Osobe s nedostatkom vitamina D spavale su oko 23 minute manje od onih s normalnim nivoom.
People with a vitamin D deficiency slept about 23 minutes less than those with a normal level.
Autori naglašavaju da studija pokazuje vezu, ali ne dokazuje da vitamin D direktno poboljšava san.
The authors stress that the study shows a link, but does not prove that vitamin D directly improves sleep.
Nisu znali da li su ljudi vitamin D dobili iz hrane, od sunca ili iz tableta.
They did not know whether people got vitamin D from food, from the sun or from tablets.
Glavni autor Adam Spira rekao je da bi to trebalo detaljnije istražiti.
The lead author Adam Spira said that this should be researched in more detail.
Problemi sa spavanjem česti su kod starijih osoba i povezani su s dijabetesom i bolestima srca.
Sleep problems are common in older people and are linked to diabetes and heart disease.

title: Sabit Šljivo privremeno vodi Željezničar do novog trenera
Sabit Šljivo temporarily leads Željezničar until a new coach
body: Željezničar je objavio ko će voditi ekipu dok klub ne izabere novog trenera.
Željezničar has announced who will lead the team until the club chooses a new coach.
Glavni trener bit će Sabit Šljivo, a uz njega su još četiri člana stručnog štaba.
The head coach will be Sabit Šljivo, and with him are four more members of the coaching staff.
To su Milan Gutović, Kenan Hasagić, Emil Šabanović i Matic Lukman Čoko.
They are Milan Gutović, Kenan Hasagić, Emil Šabanović and Matic Lukman Čoko.
Prvi test bit će utakmica protiv Veleža u Mostaru u subotu, 28. novembra, u 16:00.
The first test will be the match against Velež in Mostar on Saturday, 28 November, at 16:00.
To je utakmica 15. kola WWIN lige BiH na stadionu Rođeni.
It is a match of the 15th round of the WWIN League of BiH at Rođeni stadium.
Klub je prekinuo saradnju sa španskim trenerom Davidom Muslerom nakon poraza od Borca.
The club ended its cooperation with Spanish coach David Muslera after the defeat against Borac.
Borac je 21. novembra na Grbavici pobijedio Željezničar 4:0.
On 21 November Borac beat Željezničar 4:0 at Grbavica.
Muslera je vodio ekipu na 15 utakmica i imao je četiri pobjede, četiri neriješena rezultata i sedam poraza.
Muslera led the team in 15 matches and had four wins, four draws and seven defeats.
Gol-razlika u tom periodu bila je 14:25.
The goal difference in that period was 14:25.
Željezničar je posljednji put u ligi pobijedio 9. septembra, kada je u derbiju savladao Sarajevo 2:0.
Željezničar last won in the league on 9 September, when it beat Sarajevo 2:0 in the derby.

title: Ko je Đorđe Ždrale, bjegunac kojeg traži policija
Who is Đorđe Ždrale, the fugitive the police are looking for
body: Đorđe Ždrale je čovjek oko kojeg se vrti akcija "Emisar", u kojoj je uhapšeno pet osoba.
Đorđe Ždrale is the man at the centre of the "Emisar" operation, in which five people were arrested.
Među njima su Naser Orić i Nikolina Šljivić.
Among them are Naser Orić and Nikolina Šljivić.
Policija sumnja da su mu pomagali da se skriva i da su skrivali dokaze.
Police suspect that they helped him hide and that they hid evidence.
Ždrale je iz Istočnog Novog Sarajeva i jedan je od najpoznatijih ljudi iz podzemlja u BiH.
Ždrale is from Istočno Novo Sarajevo and is one of the best-known figures of the underworld in BiH.
Osumnjičen je da je 2. augusta teško ranio Kostu Pandurevića i od tada je u bijegu.
He is suspected of seriously wounding Kosta Pandurević on 2 August and has been on the run since then.
Policija ga traži skoro četiri mjeseca, a u augustu je rekla da se možda krije u Federaciji BiH.
Police have been looking for him for almost four months, and in August they said he might be hiding in the Federation of BiH.
Orić i Ždrale godinama se javno druže, a Orić je bio i na njegovom vjenčanju u novembru 2025. godine.
Orić and Ždrale have socialised publicly for years, and Orić was also at his wedding in November 2025.
Sud BiH osudio je Ždralu 2010. godine na 20 godina zatvora zbog ubistva Ljubiše Savića Mauzera.
In 2010 the Court of BiH sentenced Ždrale to 20 years in prison for the murder of Ljubiša Savić Mauzer.
Savić je bio bivši šef policije u RS-u, a ubijen je 2000. godine u Bijeljini.
Savić was a former police chief in RS, and he was killed in 2000 in Bijeljina.
Ždrale je izašao iz zatvora u februaru 2022. godine, nakon što je odslužio 12 godina.
Ždrale left prison in February 2022, after he had served 12 years.

title: Evropska komisija upozorila vlast u RS-u zbog novog ustava
The European Commission warns the RS authorities over a new constitution
body: Evropska komisija kaže da pažljivo prati planove vlasti u Republici Srpskoj o novom ustavu.
The European Commission says it is closely following the plans of the authorities in Republika Srpska for a new constitution.
Portparol Komisije odgovorio je na pitanja agencije DTT-NET.
A Commission spokesperson answered questions from the agency DTT-NET.
On je napisao da je Ustav BiH najviši zakon u državi i da se mora poštovati.
He wrote that the Constitution of BiH is the highest law in the country and that it must be respected.
Sve izmjene ustava entiteta moraju biti u skladu s odlukama Ustavnog suda BiH.
All changes to the entity constitutions must be in line with the decisions of the Constitutional Court of BiH.
Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik rekao je da Narodna skupština RS-a treba završiti novi ustav do februara.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik said the National Assembly of RS should finish the new constitution by February.
Nacrt ustava usvojen je 13. marta 2025. godine na prijedlog SNSD-a.
The draft constitution was adopted on 13 March 2025 on the proposal of SNSD.
Prema nacrtu, RS bi imao svoju vojsku, a Banja Luka bi bila glavni grad umjesto Sarajeva.
According to the draft, RS would have its own army, and Banja Luka would be the capital instead of Sarajevo.
Zakoni državnog parlamenta važili bi u RS-u tek kada ih potvrdi Narodna skupština.
Laws of the state parliament would apply in RS only once the National Assembly confirms them.
Ustavni sud BiH poništio je 27. marta odluku o tom nacrtu.
On 27 March the Constitutional Court of BiH annulled the decision on that draft.
Sud je naredio svim organima RS-a da prestanu s aktivnostima na osnovu te odluke.
The court ordered all RS bodies to stop activities based on that decision.
Dodik je više puta rekao da bi RS mogao proglasiti nezavisnost ako BiH ne bude funkcionisala prema Dejtonskom sporazumu.
Dodik has said several times that RS could declare independence if BiH does not function according to the Dayton Agreement.

title: Željezničar kaže da mu napad na Šošića nije prijavljen
Željezničar says the attack on Šošić was not reported to it
body: Željezničar je odgovorio na izjave svog igrača Madžida Šošića.
Željezničar has responded to the statements of its player Madžid Šošić.
Šošić je u intervjuu rekao da ga je jedan navijač fizički napao na treningu i da klub nije reagovao.
In an interview Šošić said that a fan physically attacked him at training and that the club did not react.
Rekao je i da igrači četiri mjeseca nisu dobili platu.
He also said that the players had not received their salary for four months.
Klub kaže da osuđuje svaki oblik nasilja, ali da mu napad niko nije prijavio.
The club says it condemns every form of violence, but that nobody reported the attack to it.
Prema klubu, igrači su dobili tri plate, a većina i četiri, a posljednja je isplaćena 22. oktobra.
According to the club, the players received three salaries, and most of them four, and the last one was paid on 22 October.
Većina zaposlenih potpisala je dogovor da se stari dugovi isplate do aprila 2027. godine.
Most employees signed an agreement that old debts be paid by April 2027.
Šošić je jedan od tri igrača koji nisu htjeli potpisati taj dogovor.
Šošić is one of three players who did not want to sign that agreement.
Klub tvrdi da je Šošić dobijao punu platu dok se deset mjeseci oporavljao od teške povrede.
The club claims that Šošić received his full salary while he was recovering from a serious injury for ten months.
Također kaže da se nakon povratka više puta neprimjereno ponašao prema treneru i saigračima.
It also says that after his return he behaved inappropriately towards the coach and teammates several times.
Šošić je ove sezone odigrao 12 utakmica i imao je jednu asistenciju.
This season Šošić has played 12 matches and had one assist.

title: U BKC-u otvorena izložba fotografija o Dobrinji u ratu
An exhibition of photographs about Dobrinja in the war opens at BKC
body: U galeriji BKC u Sarajevu otvorena je izložba fotografija "Dvostruki obruč – Dobrinja u ratu".
The photo exhibition "Double Ring – Dobrinja at War" has opened at the BKC gallery in Sarajevo.
Autor fotografija je fotograf Rikard Larma.
The author of the photographs is photographer Rikard Larma.
Izložba je dio obilježavanja Dana državnosti BiH, koji je 25. novembra.
The exhibition is part of marking Statehood Day of BiH, which is on 25 November.
Fotografije pokazuju život u sarajevskom naselju Dobrinja za vrijeme opsade od 1992. do 1995. godine.
The photographs show life in the Sarajevo neighbourhood of Dobrinja during the siege from 1992 to 1995.
Na njima se vide razaranja i patnja, ali i hrabrost i snaga stanovnika.
They show destruction and suffering, but also the courage and strength of the residents.
Tu su portreti boraca, vatrogasaca i medicinskog osoblja.
There are portraits of fighters, firefighters and medical staff.
Na jednoj fotografiji vidi se tabla "Pazi snajper", a na drugoj djeca s odraslima režu drva.
One photograph shows a sign "Watch out, sniper", and another shows children cutting firewood with adults.
Iz BKC-a kažu da izložba nije samo historijski dokument.
BKC says the exhibition is not just a historical document.
Prema njihovim riječima, ona podsjeća na ljude i njihove sudbine i na važnost zajedničkog sjećanja.
In their words, it reminds people of the people and their fates and of the importance of shared memory.
Izložba je otvorena do 6. decembra, svaki dan od 10:00 do 19:00.
The exhibition is open until 6 December, every day from 10:00 to 19:00.

title: Naser Orić bit će odveden na ispitivanje u Banju Luku
Naser Orić will be taken to Banja Luka for questioning
body: Naser Orić bit će prebačen u Banju Luku, javio je RTRS.
Naser Orić will be transferred to Banja Luka, RTRS reported.
Orić je uhapšen jutros kod Olova u akciji koja se zove "Emisar".
Orić was arrested this morning near Olovo in an operation called "Emisar".
Policija je pretresla njegovu imovinu, a onda ga je odvela u sjedište SIPA-e u Istočnom Sarajevu.
Police searched his property and then took him to the SIPA headquarters in Istočno Sarajevo.
U policijsku stanicu doveden je s lisicama na rukama, dok je žandarmerija blokirala prilaze zgradi.
He was brought to the police station in handcuffs, while the gendarmerie blocked the approaches to the building.
U akciji su uhapšeni i bivša poslanica Nikolina Šljivić, advokat Siniša Derganc te Mesud Mustafić i njegov sin Mustafa.
Former MP Nikolina Šljivić, lawyer Siniša Derganc and Mesud Mustafić and his son Mustafa were also arrested in the operation.
MUP RS-a kaže da su oni pomagali Đorđu Ždrali da pobjegne i da su skrivali dokaze.
The RS Ministry of the Interior says they helped Đorđe Ždrale escape and that they hid evidence.
Policija je pronašla osam pištolja, 30.000 KM, 10.000 eura, mobitele i računar.
Police found eight pistols, 30,000 KM, 10,000 euros, mobile phones and a computer.
Akciju su zajedno provele SIPA i policija RS-a, pod nadzorom posebnog odjela tužilaštva.
The operation was carried out jointly by SIPA and the RS police, under the supervision of a special department of the prosecutor's office.
Ždrale je osumnjičen da je 2. augusta u Istočnom Novom Sarajevu pucao na Kostu Pandurevića.
Ždrale is suspected of shooting at Kosta Pandurević on 2 August in Istočno Novo Sarajevo.
Od tada je u bijegu, a policija ga i dalje traži.
He has been on the run since then, and police are still looking for him.

title: Ko smije raditi na Dan državnosti u Federaciji BiH
Who may work on Statehood Day in the Federation of BiH
body: Srijeda, 25. novembar, Dan je državnosti Bosne i Hercegovine i neradni dan u Federaciji BiH.
Wednesday, 25 November, is the Statehood Day of Bosnia and Herzegovina and a non-working day in the Federation of BiH.
Tog dana ne rade državni organi, kompanije i druga pravna lica.
On that day state bodies, companies and other legal entities do not work.
Praznik traje samo jedan dan, pa je četvrtak normalan radni dan.
The holiday lasts only one day, so Thursday is a normal working day.
U Republici Srpskoj 25. novembar nije neradni dan.
In Republika Srpska, 25 November is not a non-working day.
Prema zakonu o trgovini, prodavnice u Federaciji moraju biti zatvorene nedjeljom i na praznike.
According to the trade law, shops in the Federation must be closed on Sundays and on holidays.
Ipak, smiju raditi cvjećare, pekare, apoteke i prodavnice na benzinskim pumpama, aerodromima i stanicama.
However, florists, bakeries, pharmacies and shops at petrol stations, airports and stations may work.
Kafići i restorani nisu prodavnice, zato njihovo radno vrijeme određuju kantoni i općine.
Cafés and restaurants are not shops, so their working hours are set by the cantons and municipalities.
Trgovac koji otvori prodavnicu bez dozvole može platiti kaznu od 2.000 do 15.000 KM.
A trader who opens a shop without permission can pay a fine of 2,000 to 15,000 KM.
Radnici koji rade na praznik imaju pravo na veću platu, ali zakon ne kaže za koliko posto.
Workers who work on the holiday have the right to higher pay, but the law does not say by what percentage.
Taj iznos određuje kolektivni ugovor, pravilnik ili ugovor o radu.
That amount is set by the collective agreement, the work rules or the employment contract.
Poslodavac koji ne plati veću platu može dobiti kaznu od 1.000 do 3.000 KM.
An employer who does not pay the higher wage can get a fine of 1,000 to 3,000 KM.
Prošle godine inspektori su u Hercegovini kaznili 13 trgovaca koji su radili na Dan državnosti.
Last year inspectors in Herzegovina fined 13 traders who worked on Statehood Day.

title: Virusna infekcija može oslabiti imunitet i nakon oporavka
A viral infection can weaken immunity even after recovery
body: Naučnici iz Barcelone otkrili su da virusna infekcija može dugo slabiti imunitet, čak i nakon oporavka.
Scientists from Barcelona have found that a viral infection can weaken immunity for a long time, even after recovery.
Istraživanje je urađeno na miševima na Univerzitetu Pompeu Fabra.
The research was done on mice at Pompeu Fabra University.
Rezultati su objavljeni u naučnom časopisu Cell Death & Disease.
The results were published in the scientific journal Cell Death & Disease.
Miševi su pobijedili virus, ali promjene u njihovoj slezeni ostale su mnogo duže.
The mice beat the virus, but the changes in their spleen remained much longer.
Slezena je organ koji pomaže tijelu da se bori protiv infekcija.
The spleen is an organ that helps the body fight infections.
U njoj se stvorilo tkivo slično ožiljku, a imunološke ćelije više nisu bile dobro raspoređene.
Tissue similar to a scar formed in it, and the immune cells were no longer well arranged.
Zato su miševi sporije reagovali na nove infekcije.
That is why the mice reacted more slowly to new infections.
Miševi koji su prije infekcije vakcinisani nisu imali te promjene.
Mice that were vaccinated before the infection did not have those changes.
Profesor Andreas Meyerhans rekao je da ljudi obično misle da su takve infekcije blage i prolazne.
Professor Andreas Meyerhans said that people usually think such infections are mild and temporary.
Prema njegovim riječima, ta slika možda ne pokazuje posljedice koje se ne vide odmah.
In his words, that picture may not show consequences that are not visible immediately.
Istraživanje je rađeno samo na miševima, pa još nije jasno da li se isto dešava kod ljudi.
The research was done only on mice, so it is not yet clear whether the same happens in people.

title: Kina će s pomoću AI i podvodnih robota istraživati historiju
China will explore history with AI and underwater robots
body: Kina je objavila plan za arheologiju do 2030. godine.
China has published a plan for archaeology until 2030.
Plan je krajem oktobra predstavila državna uprava za kulturno naslijeđe, a ima sedam glavnih zadataka.
The plan was presented at the end of October by the state administration for cultural heritage, and it has seven main tasks.
U njegovom središtu su umjetna inteligencija, analiza drevne DNK i podvodni roboti.
At its centre are artificial intelligence, the analysis of ancient DNA and underwater robots.
Kina će razviti posebne modele umjetne inteligencije koji bi prepoznavali predmete i spajali slomljene dijelove.
China will develop special artificial intelligence models that would recognise objects and join broken pieces.
Takvi modeli mogli bi i virtualno popraviti oštećene predmete.
Such models could also virtually repair damaged objects.
Bit će izgrađeno nekoliko novih laboratorija, među njima i jedna za arheologiju dubokog mora.
Several new laboratories will be built, among them one for deep-sea archaeology.
Podvodni roboti tragat će za ostacima prošlosti u Južnom i Istočnom kineskom moru.
Underwater robots will search for remains of the past in the South and East China Seas.
Kina planira i 5 do 10 zajedničkih projekata sa stranim partnerima, na primjer u Egiptu, Grčkoj i Centralnoj Aziji.
China also plans 5 to 10 joint projects with foreign partners, for example in Egypt, Greece and Central Asia.
Hongkonški list South China Morning Post piše da je jedan cilj jačanje kineskog kulturnog utjecaja u svijetu.
The Hong Kong newspaper South China Morning Post writes that one aim is to strengthen Chinese cultural influence in the world.
Kina ima 65 nacionalnih arheoloških parkova.
China has 65 national archaeological parks.
Broj posjeta porastao je s oko 21 milion 2021. na skoro 98 miliona 2025. godine.
The number of visits rose from about 21 million in 2021 to almost 98 million in 2025.

title: Iza Neptuna bi se mogla kriti nova planeta
A new planet could be hiding beyond Neptune
body: Astronomi misle da bi se iza Neptuna mogla kriti planeta do dva puta teža od Zemlje.
Astronomers think that a planet up to twice as heavy as Earth could be hiding beyond Neptune.
Ideju je predstavio Patryk Sofia Lykawka s univerziteta u Australiji, koji radi i u Japanu.
The idea was presented by Patryk Sofia Lykawka from a university in Australia, who also works in Japan.
Studija je objavljena u časopisu Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
The study was published in the journal Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
Naučnici su moguću planetu nazvali Planeta X2.
The scientists called the possible planet Planet X2.
Ona bi imala izduženu putanju i nikada ne bi bila bliže Suncu od 200 astronomskih jedinica.
It would have an elongated orbit and would never be closer to the Sun than 200 astronomical units.
Jedna astronomska jedinica je prosječna udaljenost Zemlje od Sunca.
One astronomical unit is the average distance of Earth from the Sun.
Tim je napravio simulacije koje pokazuju 4,5 milijardi godina historije Sunčevog sistema.
The team made simulations that show 4.5 billion years of the history of the Solar System.
Takva planeta mogla bi objasniti čudne putanje nekih dalekih objekata, kao što je Sedna.
Such a planet could explain the strange orbits of some distant objects, such as Sedna.
Lykawka je rekao da bi otkriće nove planete promijenilo naše razumijevanje historije Sunčevog sistema.
Lykawka said that the discovery of a new planet would change our understanding of the history of the Solar System.
Ipak, Planetu X2 još niko nije vidio i to je samo hipoteza.
However, nobody has seen Planet X2 yet and it is only a hypothesis.
Teoriju bi mogla provjeriti opservatorija Vera C. Rubin, koja sada snima nebo.
The theory could be checked by the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, which is now surveying the sky.

title: Federalno tužilaštvo: Slučaj Konaković je prioritet
Federal Prosecutor's Office: The Konaković case is a priority
body: Federalno tužilaštvo danas se oglasilo o predmetu u kojem se spominje Elmedin Konaković.
The Federal Prosecutor's Office spoke today about a case in which Elmedin Konaković is mentioned.
Konaković je ranije zatražio nadzor nad istragom o dodjeli budžetskog novca dok je bio predsjedavajući Skupštine Kantona Sarajevo.
Konaković had earlier requested supervision of the investigation into the allocation of budget money while he was speaker of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly.
Tužilaštvo je potvrdilo da je njegov zahtjev primilo 19. novembra.
The prosecutor's office confirmed that it received his request on 19 November.
Istraga je otvorena 2. oktobra 2026. godine i obuhvata 3 osobe.
The investigation was opened on 2 October 2026 and covers 3 people.
One se sumnjiče za zloupotrebu položaja ili ovlaštenja.
They are suspected of abuse of office or authority.
Predmet je prešao iz Kantonalnog tužilaštva u Posebni odjel Federalnog tužilaštva, a vodi ga tužilac Samir Selimović.
The case moved from the Cantonal Prosecutor's Office to the Special Department of the Federal Prosecutor's Office, and prosecutor Samir Selimović is in charge of it.
Slučaj je na listi prioriteta tog odjela za 2026. godinu.
The case is on that department's priority list for 2026.
Tužilaštvo je reagovalo zbog tvrdnji u javnosti o selektivnom postupanju i ciljanom progonu nekih osoba.
The prosecutor's office reacted because of public claims about selective treatment and targeted prosecution of certain people.
Glavni federalni tužilac pregledat će Konakovićev zahtjev i obavijestiti ga o mjerama.
The Chief Federal Prosecutor will review Konaković's request and inform him of the measures.
Prema dokazima, i druge osobe su možda prekršile pravila o dodjeli novca udruženjima, a njihov dio predmeta ide kantonalnom tužilaštvu.
According to the evidence, other people may also have broken the rules on giving money to associations, and their part of the case will go to the cantonal prosecutor's office.

title: U Sarajevu počinje prvi WITNESS Festival
The first WITNESS Festival begins in Sarajevo
body: Prvi WITNESS Festival počinje večeras u Sarajevu i trajat će do 28. novembra.
The first WITNESS Festival begins tonight in Sarajevo and will last until 28 November.
Organizuju ga Obala Art Centar, koji stoji iza Sarajevo Film Festivala, i WARM Fondacija.
It is organised by Obala Art Centar, which is behind the Sarajevo Film Festival, and the WARM Foundation.
Karte za obje večerašnje projekcije već su rasprodane.
Tickets for both of tonight's screenings are already sold out.
Filmovi se prikazuju u tri kina: Meeting Pointu, Cineplexxu i Kvartovskom kinu Grbavica.
The films are shown in three cinemas: Meeting Point, Cineplexx and the Grbavica neighbourhood cinema.
Do kraja festivala traju i dvije besplatne izložbe fotografija, a neki ratni fotografi doći će kao gosti.
Two free photo exhibitions also run until the end of the festival, and some war photographers will come as guests.
Meeting Point je centar festivala, pa se tamo nakon projekcija održavaju razgovori i koncerti.
Meeting Point is the centre of the festival, so talks and concerts take place there after the screenings.
Večeras u 22:20 nastupa Duda Buržujka, satirični lik glumice Julije Petković iz Niša.
Tonight at 22:20 Duda Buržujka performs, a satirical character of actress Julija Petković from Niš.
U srijedu u 11 sati rediteljica Sophie Fiennes govorit će o tome kako ideja postaje film.
On Wednesday at 11 o'clock, director Sophie Fiennes will talk about how an idea becomes a film.
Ona dugo sarađuje s filozofom Slavojem Žižekom, a njihov zajednički film prikazuje se u 21 sat.
She has worked with the philosopher Slavoj Žižek for a long time, and their joint film is showing at 21:00.
Publika će vidjeti i dokumentarac Damira Markovine o njegovom ocu, koji je u ratu ostao u Mostaru.
The audience will also see Damir Markovina's documentary about his father, who stayed in Mostar during the war.

title: Klix pokrenuo arhiv sa 150.000 vijesti iz starih novina
Klix launches an archive with 150,000 news items from old newspapers
body: Portal Klix.ba uoči Dana državnosti pokrenuo je Vremeplov, besplatni internetski arhiv starih bosanskohercegovačkih novina.
Ahead of Statehood Day, the portal Klix.ba has launched Vremeplov, a free online archive of old Bosnian-Herzegovinian newspapers.
Arhiv se nalazi na adresi vremeplov.klix.ba i otvoren je za sve čitaoce.
The archive is at vremeplov.klix.ba and is open to all readers.
U njemu je skoro 150.000 vijesti iz 18 novina koje su izlazile od 1866. do 1942. godine.
It contains almost 150,000 news items from 18 newspapers that were published from 1866 to 1942.
Novine je digitalizovala Nacionalna i univerzitetska biblioteka BiH, a Klix je dobio pismenu dozvolu da koristi te snimke.
The newspapers were digitised by the National and University Library of BiH, and Klix received written permission to use those scans.
Tekstove iz novina na njemačkom jeziku preveli su na bosanski uz pomoć vještačke inteligencije.
Texts from German-language newspapers were translated into Bosnian with the help of artificial intelligence.
Stari tekstovi, i oni pisani ćirilicom, prepisani su u današnji pravopis.
Old texts, including those written in Cyrillic, were transcribed into today's spelling.
Čitaoci mogu tražiti vijesti po riječi, imenu ili mjestu, a rezultate mogu filtrirati po godini i novinama.
Readers can search for news by word, name or place, and they can filter the results by year and newspaper.
Uz svaku vijest stoji i isječak originalne stranice, naziv novina i datum broja.
Each news item also comes with a clipping of the original page, the name of the newspaper and the date of the issue.
U arhivu se može čitati o aneksiji, Sarajevskom atentatu i ratnim godinama, ali i o cijenama hljeba i šećera.
In the archive you can read about the annexation, the Sarajevo assassination and the war years, but also about the prices of bread and sugar.
Klix upozorava da mašinski prijevodi mogu imati greške, zato je originalni snimak uvijek tačna verzija.
Klix warns that machine translations may contain errors, so the original scan is always the accurate version.

title: Kako su tužioci snimili predaju 100.000 KM svjedoku
How prosecutors recorded the handover of 100,000 KM to a witness
body: Policija je jutros uhapsila Nasera Orića, Nikolinu Šljivić i još nekoliko osoba u akciji "Emisar".
This morning the police arrested Naser Orić, Nikolina Šljivić and several other people in operation "Emisar".
Sumnja se da su pomagali Đorđu Ždrali, koji se krije od policije od augusta.
They are suspected of having helped Đorđe Ždrale, who has been hiding from the police since August.
Portal Istraga.ba objavio je kako je došlo do hapšenja.
The portal Istraga.ba has published how the arrests came about.
Ždrale je 2. augusta u Istočnom Sarajevu ranio Kostu Pandurevića, a nakon toga je pobjegao.
On 2 August in Istočno Sarajevo, Ždrale wounded Kosta Pandurević, and after that he fled.
Prema pisanju portala, Orić i Šljivić su se početkom oktobra sastali s Pandurevićem.
According to the portal, Orić and Šljivić met Pandurević at the beginning of October.
Pandurević je pristao promijeniti svoj iskaz za 100.000 KM.
Pandurević agreed to change his statement for 100,000 KM.
Orić mu je novac predao krajem oktobra u jednom ugostiteljskom objektu, a tužioci su sve snimali.
Orić handed him the money at the end of October in a café or restaurant, and the prosecutors recorded everything.
Pandurević je kasnije u tužilaštvu rekao da više nije siguran da je na njega pucao Ždrale.
Pandurević later said at the prosecutor's office that he was no longer sure that Ždrale had shot him.
Mesud Mustafić i njegov sin Mustafa navodno su Ždralu nakon pucnjave odvezli prema Kladnju.
Mesud Mustafić and his son Mustafa allegedly drove Ždrale towards Kladanj after the shooting.
Obojica su policiji rekli da ih je Orić zamolio da prevezu jednog prijatelja.
Both told the police that Orić had asked them to transport a friend.

title: Nikolina Šljivić i Mustafići predati policiji u Istočnom Sarajevu
Nikolina Šljivić and the Mustafićs handed over to police in Istočno Sarajevo
body: Nikolina Šljivić, Mesud Mustafić i njegov sin Mustafa predati su danas Policijskoj upravi Istočno Sarajevo.
Nikolina Šljivić, Mesud Mustafić and his son Mustafa were handed over to the Istočno Sarajevo Police Administration today.
Sve troje uhapšeni su ranije u toku dana u akciji "Emisar".
All three were arrested earlier in the day in operation "Emisar".
U istoj akciji uhapšeni su i Naser Orić i advokat Siniša Dargenc.
Naser Orić and lawyer Siniša Dargenc were also arrested in the same operation.
MUP Republike Srpske saopćio je da je cilj akcije razbiti kriminalnu grupu povezanu s Đorđem Ždralom.
The Republika Srpska Ministry of the Interior announced that the aim of the operation is to break up a criminal group linked to Đorđe Ždrale.
Uhapšeni se sumnjiče za udruživanje radi činjenja krivičnih djela i za skrivanje dokaza.
The arrested are suspected of associating to commit crimes and of hiding evidence.
Sumnja se i na pokušaj teškog ubistva.
There is also suspicion of attempted aggravated murder.
Do sada je uhapšeno ukupno 5 osoba.
A total of 5 people have been arrested so far.
Akciju vodi MUP RS pod nadzorom posebnog odjela Republičkog tužilaštva, a na teritoriji Federacije pomaže SIPA.
The RS Ministry of the Interior is leading the operation under the supervision of a special department of the Republic Prosecutor's Office, and SIPA is helping on the territory of the Federation.
Đorđe Ždrale je i dalje u bijegu, a policija je pretresla i njegove objekte.
Đorđe Ždrale is still on the run, and the police have also searched his properties.
MUP je najavio da će više informacija dati kada akcija završi.
The ministry announced that it will give more information when the operation ends.

title: Zbog kvarova NASA zaustavila naučni rad dvije letjelice na Marsu
Because of faults, NASA has halted science work by two spacecraft at Mars
body: NASA je privremeno zaustavila naučni rad rovera Perseverance i letjelice Mars Odyssey.
NASA has temporarily halted the science work of the Perseverance rover and the Mars Odyssey spacecraft.
Obje letjelice imaju tehničke kvarove.
Both spacecraft have technical faults.
Rover je vozilo koje se kreće po površini planete.
A rover is a vehicle that moves across the surface of a planet.
Problemi s Perseveranceom počeli su 30. oktobra, kada je glavni radio prestao slati signale računaru.
The problems with Perseverance began on 30 October, when the main radio stopped sending signals to the computer.
Rover je tada prešao na rezervni radio, ali on radi sa samo pola snage.
The rover then switched to the backup radio, but it works at only half power.
Sada podatke šalje direktno na Zemlju, ali ta veza je mnogo sporija, pa ne snima nove fotografije.
Now it sends data directly to Earth, but that link is much slower, so it is not taking new photos.
Na letjelici Odyssey prestao je raditi jedan od četiri točka koji je drže u pravom položaju.
On the Odyssey spacecraft, one of the four wheels that keep it in the right position has stopped working.
Odyssey treba najmanje 3 točka, a jedan se pokvario još 2013. godine.
Odyssey needs at least 3 wheels, and one already broke down in 2013.
Ako ga ne poprave, letjelica bi imala gorivo za samo 1 do 2 mjeseca rada.
If they do not repair it, the spacecraft would have fuel for only 1 to 2 months of work.
NASA kaže da su obje letjelice stabilne i nada se da će krajem novembra ponovo raditi.
NASA says that both spacecraft are stable and hopes that they will work again at the end of November.

title: Umro mitropolit Irinej, poznat po spornim izjavama o BiH
Metropolitan Irinej, known for controversial statements about BiH, has died
body: Mitropolit bački Irinej Bulović umro je danas u 79. godini.
Metropolitan Irinej Bulović of Bačka died today at the age of 79.
Bio je jedan od najpoznatijih ljudi Srpske pravoslavne crkve i dugo njen portparol.
He was one of the best-known people in the Serbian Orthodox Church and its spokesperson for a long time.
Mnogi građani BiH pamtit će ga po izjavama protiv Islamske zajednice.
Many citizens of BiH will remember him for his statements against the Islamic Community.
Rođen je 1947. godine kod Sombora, a više od 30 godina predavao je na Pravoslavnom bogoslovskom fakultetu u Beogradu.
He was born in 1947 near Sombor, and for more than 30 years he taught at the Orthodox Theological Faculty in Belgrade.
Episkop bački postao je 1990, a mitropolit 2024. godine.
He became Bishop of Bačka in 1990 and Metropolitan in 2024.
Godine 2021. bio je među kandidatima za patrijarha, ali je izabran Porfirije.
In 2021 he was among the candidates for patriarch, but Porfirije was chosen.
U intervjuu krajem 2023. rekao je da neki ljudi u Islamskoj zajednici žele prvu islamsku državu u Evropi.
In an interview at the end of 2023 he said that some people in the Islamic Community want the first Islamic state in Europe.
Tada je za jednog imama iz Kozarca rekao da dolazi iz ustaškog mjesta.
At that time he said of an imam from Kozarac that he came from an Ustaše place.
Rekao je i da je crkva zamrznula svoje učešće u Međureligijskom vijeću BiH.
He also said that the church had frozen its participation in the Interreligious Council of BiH.
Godine 2018. izjavio je da je Srbija svugdje gdje žive Srbi, i u BiH i u Crnoj Gori.
In 2018 he stated that Serbia is everywhere Serbs live, including in BiH and Montenegro.

title: Uhapšen Naser Orić zbog sumnje da je skrivao Ždralu
Naser Orić arrested on suspicion of hiding Ždrale
body: Naser Orić uhapšen je jutros na području Olova.
Naser Orić was arrested this morning in the Olovo area.
Policija sumnja da je pomagao u skrivanju Đorđa Ždrale, koji je u bijegu od augusta.
The police suspect that he helped hide Đorđe Ždrale, who has been on the run since August.
Ždrale se sumnjiči da je 2. augusta u Istočnom Sarajevu pokušao ubiti Kostu Pandurevića.
Ždrale is suspected of having tried to kill Kosta Pandurević in Istočno Sarajevo on 2 August.
Akciju su od ranog jutra provodili MUP Republike Srpske i SIPA na više lokacija u BiH.
The operation was carried out from early morning by the Republika Srpska Ministry of the Interior and SIPA at several locations in BiH.
U Istočnom Sarajevu uhapšena je i bivša poslanica Nikolina Šljivić.
Former MP Nikolina Šljivić was also arrested in Istočno Sarajevo.
Na listi uhapšenih je i Mesud Mustafić iz Vogošće.
Mesud Mustafić from Vogošća is also on the list of those arrested.
Istražitelji misle da je on, a da to nije znao, prevezao Ždralu iz Sarajeva u Tuzlanski kanton.
Investigators believe that he, without knowing it, transported Ždrale from Sarajevo to Tuzla Canton.
Akciju je naredilo Republičko javno tužilaštvo, a naloge je izdao Okružni sud u Banjoj Luci.
The operation was ordered by the Republic Public Prosecutor's Office, and the warrants were issued by the District Court in Banja Luka.
Klix.ba je potvrdio da policija od jutra pretresa kuće i druge objekte koje koristi Orić.
Klix.ba confirmed that the police have been searching houses and other properties used by Orić since the morning.
Prema dostupnim informacijama, Ždrale u ovoj akciji nije pronađen.
According to available information, Ždrale was not found in this operation.

title: Ruski vojni avioni izazvali paniku na južnokorejskom ostrvu
Russian military planes cause panic on a South Korean island
body: Stanovnici južnokorejskog ostrva Ulleungdo dobili su upozorenje da se sklone, jer su se blizu ostrva pojavili ruski vojni avioni.
Residents of the South Korean island of Ulleungdo received a warning to take shelter, because Russian military planes appeared near the island.
Ostrvo se nalazi oko 120 kilometara od istočne obale Južne Koreje.
The island lies about 120 kilometres from the east coast of South Korea.
Južnokorejska vojska kaže da su avioni ušli u zonu protivzračne identifikacije.
The South Korean military says that the planes entered the air defence identification zone.
Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova poslalo je u 7:52 hitnu poruku za oko 8.700 stanovnika.
At 7:52 the Ministry of the Interior sent an emergency message to about 8,700 residents.
Televizijski program je prekinut, a ljudima je rečeno da se spreme za odlazak u skloništa.
The TV programme was interrupted, and people were told to get ready to go to shelters.
Upozorenje je ukinuto već u 7:55, ali su na ostrvu svirale sirene.
The warning was lifted already at 7:55, but sirens sounded on the island.
Južnokorejsko zrakoplovstvo poslalo je svoje borbene avione.
The South Korean air force sent up its fighter jets.
Jedan građevinski radnik rekao je da je odmah pobjegao s gradilišta kada je dobio poruku.
One construction worker said that he immediately ran from the building site when he got the message.
Lokalne vlasti su kasnije priznale da su greškom poslale i poruku o sjevernokorejskom avionu.
Local authorities later admitted that they had by mistake also sent a message about a North Korean plane.
Ministarstvo odbrane planira pozvati ruskog vojnog atašea i uložiti oštar protest.
The Ministry of Defence plans to summon the Russian military attaché and lodge a strong protest.

title: U akciji protiv narkokartela u Meksiku poginulo 20 osoba
20 people killed in an operation against a drug cartel in Mexico
body: Meksička vojska izvela je u gradu Guasave akciju hvatanja vođe kartela Fausta Isidra Meze Floresa.
The Mexican army carried out an operation in the town of Guasave to capture cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.
On je poznat kao El Chapo Isidro, a akcija je počela 20. novembra navečer.
He is known as El Chapo Isidro, and the operation began on the evening of 20 November.
U sukobu je poginulo 20 osoba, među njima 16 članova kriminalne grupe i 4 vojnika.
20 people were killed in the clash, among them 16 members of the criminal group and 4 soldiers.
Ministar odbrane Ricardo Trevilla Trejo rekao je da je ranjeno još 10 vojnika.
Defence Minister Ricardo Trevilla Trejo said that another 10 soldiers were wounded.
U akciji su učestvovali pripadnici vojske i Nacionalne garde, njih 361, uz više helikoptera.
361 members of the army and the National Guard took part in the operation, along with several helicopters.
Uhapšeno je 16 osoba, a policija je zaplijenila 28 komada oružja.
16 people were arrested, and the police seized 28 weapons.
Među uhapšenima su i dva rođaka Meze Floresa, koji su važni u organizaciji.
Among those arrested are also two relatives of Meza Flores, who are important in the organisation.
Trevilla je rekao da je Meksiko 3 mjeseca razmjenjivao informacije sa SAD-om.
Trevilla said that Mexico had exchanged information with the US for 3 months.
FBI ga je još u februaru 2025. godine stavio na listu 10 najtraženijih bjegunaca.
Back in February 2025 the FBI put him on its list of the 10 most wanted fugitives.
U SAD-u ga terete za trgovinu kokainom, metamfetaminom i fentanilom.
In the US he is charged with trafficking cocaine, methamphetamine and fentanyl.

title: Tramvaji jutros ne voze do Baščaršije zbog kvara
Trams not running to Baščaršija this morning because of a breakdown
body: Tramvaji u Sarajevu jutros ne voze na dionici od Čengić Vile do Baščaršije.
Trams in Sarajevo are not running this morning on the section from Čengić Vila to Baščaršija.
Saobraćaj radi samo na dijelu linije od Ilidže do Čengić Vile.
Service is running only on the part of the line from Ilidža to Čengić Vila.
Javno preduzeće GRAS potvrdilo je da se jedan tramvaj pokvario kod Kampusa Univerziteta u Sarajevu.
The public company GRAS confirmed that one tram broke down near the University of Sarajevo Campus.
Zbog kvara tramvaji ne mogu ići prema centru grada.
Because of the breakdown, trams cannot go towards the city centre.
Na stajalištima su se zato skupile velike gužve, a putnici traže drugi prevoz.
Large crowds have therefore gathered at the stops, and passengers are looking for other transport.
Mnogi žele stići od Čengić Vile do Baščaršije autobusom.
Many want to get from Čengić Vila to Baščaršija by bus.
Putnici u Sarajevu i inače ujutro često dugo čekaju na tramvaj.
Passengers in Sarajevo often wait a long time for a tram in the mornings anyway.
Gužve su veće jer nema dovoljno tramvaja, iako je linija nedavno produžena do Hrasnice.
The crowds are bigger because there are not enough trams, although the line was recently extended to Hrasnica.
Zbog toga putnici često ne mogu ući u prvi tramvaj koji dođe.
Because of that, passengers often cannot get on the first tram that comes.

title: Jessica Alba mora bivšem suprugu platiti pola miliona dolara
Jessica Alba must pay her ex-husband half a million dollars
body: Sud u Los Angelesu naredio je glumici Jessici Albi da bivšem suprugu Cashu Warrenu plati 577.481 dolar.
A court in Los Angeles has ordered actress Jessica Alba to pay her ex-husband Cash Warren 577,481 dollars.
Novac dolazi iz penzijskog fonda njene kompanije HonorBar.
The money comes from the pension fund of her company HonorBar.
Odluka je donesena u petak, 20. novembra, a objavio ju je portal Page Six.
The decision was made on Friday, 20 November, and the portal Page Six reported it.
Iznos se može promijeniti ako se vrijednost investicija do isplate poveća ili smanji.
The amount can change if the value of the investments rises or falls before the payment.
Warren novac može uzeti odjednom ili ga prebaciti u drugi penzijski fond.
Warren can take the money at once or move it to another pension fund.
Alba mu je ranije pristala platiti i 3 miliona dolara, u dvije rate po 1,5 miliona.
Alba had earlier also agreed to pay him 3 million dollars, in two instalments of 1.5 million each.
Warren dobija i polovinu njene zarade od reprize serija snimljenih tokom braka.
Warren also receives half of her earnings from reruns of series filmed during the marriage.
Alba i Warren upoznali su se 2004. godine na snimanju filma Fantastična četvorka.
Alba and Warren met in 2004 while filming the movie Fantastic Four.
Vjenčali su se 2008. godine, a razišli su se u decembru 2024. godine nakon 16 godina braka.
They married in 2008, and they separated in December 2024 after 16 years of marriage.
Imaju troje djece, o kojima brinu zajedno.
They have three children, whom they look after together.

title: Pucketanje prstiju ne izaziva artritis, pokazuju istraživanja
Cracking your knuckles does not cause arthritis, research shows
body: Mnogi ljudi vjeruju da pucketanje prstiju izaziva artritis, odnosno upalu zglobova.
Many people believe that cracking your knuckles causes arthritis, that is, inflammation of the joints.
Istraživanja pokazuju da to nije tačno, a prste redovno pucketa 25 do 45 posto ljudi.
Research shows that this is not true, and 25 to 45 percent of people crack their knuckles regularly.
Jedan američki ljekar je to provjeravao na sebi čak 50 godina.
One American doctor checked this on himself for as many as 50 years.
Donald Unger je najmanje dva puta dnevno pucketao prste lijeve ruke, a desnu nije.
Donald Unger cracked the knuckles of his left hand at least twice a day, but not his right.
Godine 1998. napisao je da nema artritisa ni na jednoj ruci.
In 1998 he wrote that there was no arthritis in either hand.
Za ovaj eksperiment dobio je 2009. godine šaljivu nagradu Ig Nobel.
For this experiment he received the humorous Ig Nobel prize in 2009.
Studija iz 2011. godine s 215 ljudi pokazala je da artritis nije češći kod onih koji pucketaju prstima.
A 2011 study with 215 people showed that arthritis is not more common among those who crack their knuckles.
Istraživači iz Kanade otkrili su 2015. godine da zvuk nastaje kada se u tečnosti u zglobu stvori šupljina s plinom.
Researchers from Canada discovered in 2015 that the sound occurs when a cavity with gas forms in the fluid in the joint.
Ljekari ipak kažu da pucketanje ne bi trebalo boljeti.
Doctors still say that cracking should not hurt.
Ako se pojave bol, otok ili slabiji stisak, treba otići ljekaru.
If pain, swelling or a weaker grip appear, you should go to a doctor.

title: Jutros moguća poledica na cestama i magla u BiH
Possible black ice on roads and fog in BiH this morning
body: Vozači u Bosni i Hercegovini jutros moraju biti oprezni, jer su temperature niske.
Drivers in Bosnia and Herzegovina must be careful this morning, because temperatures are low.
Na svim vlažnim dionicama cesta moguća je poledica, odnosno tanak sloj leda.
On all wet sections of road black ice is possible, that is, a thin layer of ice.
U sjeverozapadnim dijelovima zemlje magla mjestimično smanjuje vidljivost.
In the north-western parts of the country fog reduces visibility in places.
U Sarajevu je jutros -3 stepena, a danas se očekuje do 6 stepeni.
In Sarajevo it is -3 degrees this morning, and up to 6 degrees is expected today.
Sutra bi temperatura mogla biti od 0 do 10 stepeni.
Tomorrow the temperature could be from 0 to 10 degrees.
Zbog niskih temperatura na snazi je žuto upozorenje.
Because of the low temperatures a yellow warning is in force.
Na autoputu između Zenice jug i Zenice sjever saobraćaj je spor zbog radova kod tunela Klopče.
On the motorway between Zenica south and Zenica north traffic is slow because of works near the Klopče tunnel.
Radovi se izvode i na mnogim drugim cestama, pa se na nekim mjestima vozi jednom trakom.
Works are also being carried out on many other roads, so in some places traffic uses one lane.
Na cesti od Jablanice do Blidinja mogu voziti samo vozila do 3,5 tone.
On the road from Jablanica to Blidinje only vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes may drive.
Prema podacima BIHAMK-a, na graničnim prijelazima nema dugog čekanja za automobile.
According to BIHAMK data, there are no long waits for cars at border crossings.

title: Američki kongresmen Jimmy Gomez podnosi ostavku
US congressman Jimmy Gomez is resigning
body: Američki kongresmen Jimmy Gomez iz Kalifornije napustit će Predstavnički dom 1. decembra.
US congressman Jimmy Gomez from California will leave the House of Representatives on 1 December.
Odluku je objavio nakon što je etički odbor Kongresa našao dokaze o seksualnom uznemiravanju.
He announced the decision after the congressional ethics committee found evidence of sexual harassment.
Gomez ima 51 godinu i član je Demokratske stranke.
Gomez is 51 years old and is a member of the Democratic Party.
U izvještaju odbora piše da je imao neželjene seksualne prijedloge prema jednoj uposlenici Kongresa.
The committee's report says that he made unwanted sexual advances towards a female employee of Congress.
Žena je rekla da se to dogodilo dva puta, a odbor piše da je zbog toga napustila posao.
The woman said that it happened twice, and the committee writes that she left her job because of it.
Istraga je počela u augustu 2025. godine.
The investigation began in August 2025.
Gomez je predstavljao dio Los Angelesa pet mandata.
Gomez represented part of Los Angeles for five terms.
U pisanoj izjavi Gomez je rekao da se ne slaže s nalazima odbora.
In a written statement Gomez said that he does not agree with the committee's findings.
Ipak, rekao je da preuzima punu odgovornost za lične greške i da nema drugog izbora.
Still, he said that he takes full responsibility for personal mistakes and that he has no other choice.
On je ovog mjeseca već izgubio stranačke izbore za svoje mjesto, i to za oko 25 procentnih poena.
This month he had already lost the party election for his seat, by about 25 percentage points.

title: Kapetan broda Costa Concordia izašao iz zatvora
Captain of the Costa Concordia ship leaves prison
body: Francesco Schettino, bivši kapetan broda Costa Concordia, izašao je 20. novembra iz zatvora Rebibbia u Rimu.
Francesco Schettino, the former captain of the Costa Concordia ship, left Rebibbia prison in Rome on 20 November.
Brod je u januaru 2012. godine udario u stijene kod ostrva Giglio, a u nesreći su poginule 32 osobe.
In January 2012 the ship hit rocks near the island of Giglio, and 32 people died in the accident.
Sud u Rimu odlučio je da ostatak kazne služi uz nadzor socijalne službe.
A court in Rome decided that he will serve the rest of his sentence under the supervision of social services.
Schettino ima 66 godina i nije potpuno slobodan, jer se mora vratiti u zatvor ako prekrši pravila.
Schettino is 66 years old and is not completely free, because he must return to prison if he breaks the rules.
On će osam sati dnevno raditi za privatnog poslodavca u regiji Kampanija i volontirati.
He will work eight hours a day for a private employer in the Campania region and do volunteer work.
Od 22 do 6 sati mora biti kod kuće.
From 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. he must be at home.
Zbog dobrog ponašanja kazna mu se završava u julu 2030. godine, oko 2 godine ranije nego što je planirano.
Because of good behaviour his sentence ends in July 2030, about 2 years earlier than planned.
Sud u Grossetu osudio ga je 2015. godine na 16 godina zatvora, između ostalog zato što je napustio brod.
A court in Grosseto sentenced him in 2015 to 16 years in prison, among other things because he abandoned the ship.
U zatvor je otišao 2017. godine, a dosad je odslužio oko 9 i po godina kazne.
He went to prison in 2017, and so far he has served about 9 and a half years of the sentence.
Njegova advokatica rekla je da je njegovo ponašanje u zatvoru bilo izuzetno pozitivno.
His lawyer said that his behaviour in prison was extremely positive.

title: NATO upozorava Rusiju zbog navodnog nuklearnog satelita
NATO warns Russia over an alleged nuclear satellite
body: Generalni sekretar NATO-a Mark Rutte rekao je u Berlinu da će savez braniti svoju teritoriju i u svemiru.
NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said in Berlin that the alliance will defend its territory in space as well.
Njegova izjava dolazi nakon izvještaja njemačkih medija da Rusija sprema lansiranje satelita s nuklearnim oružjem.
His statement comes after German media reports that Russia is preparing to launch a satellite with a nuclear weapon.
Prema tim izvještajima, satelit bi mogao biti lansiran u narednih 60 dana.
According to those reports, the satellite could be launched in the next 60 days.
Mediji NDR, WDR i Süddeutsche Zeitung pišu da se satelit zove Sputnik-S i da nosi nuklearnu bojevu glavu.
The media outlets NDR, WDR and Süddeutsche Zeitung write that the satellite is called Sputnik-S and carries a nuclear warhead.
Takav satelit bi mogao ometati ili uništiti druge satelite, koji su važni za komunikaciju i nadzor.
Such a satellite could jam or destroy other satellites, which are important for communication and surveillance.
Rutte je rekao da NATO ima više načina da odgovori i da stalno jača svoju odbranu.
Rutte said that NATO has several ways to respond and that it is constantly strengthening its defence.
Njemački kancelar Friedrich Merz nije potvrdio ove informacije, ali je rekao da su šokantne.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz did not confirm this information, but he said that it is shocking.
Šef Evropske svemirske agencije Josef Aschbacher rekao je da bi nuklearno oružje u svemiru bilo najgori mogući scenarij.
The head of the European Space Agency, Josef Aschbacher, said that nuclear weapons in space would be the worst possible scenario.
Kremlj je odbacio ove tvrdnje, a ruska ambasada u Berlinu govori o propagandi.
The Kremlin rejected these claims, and the Russian embassy in Berlin speaks of propaganda.
Rusija je potpisala sporazum iz 1967. godine, koji zabranjuje oružje za masovno uništenje u orbiti.
Russia signed a 1967 treaty which bans weapons of mass destruction in orbit.

title: Ustavni sud objasnio zašto je poništio veto Željke Cvijanović
Constitutional Court explains why it annulled Željka Cvijanović's veto
body: Ustavni sud BiH objavio je u ponedjeljak obrazloženje odluke o vetu Željke Cvijanović.
The Constitutional Court of BiH published on Monday the reasoning behind its decision on Željka Cvijanović's veto.
Sud je veto poništio još 19. novembra, a odluku je podržalo 7 sudija.
The court annulled the veto back on 19 November, and 7 judges supported the decision.
Potpredsjednica suda Valerija Galić dala je izjavu o neslaganju.
The court's vice-president, Valerija Galić, gave a dissenting statement.
Predsjedništvo BiH je 29. juna imenovalo članove Komisije za očuvanje nacionalnih spomenika.
On 29 June the BiH Presidency appointed the members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments.
Za odluku su glasali Denis Bećirović i Željko Komšić, dok je Cvijanović bila protiv.
Denis Bećirović and Željko Komšić voted for the decision, while Cvijanović was against.
Ona je zatim rekla da je odluka štetna za vitalni interes Republike Srpske, a Narodna skupština RS-a to je potvrdila 7. jula.
She then said the decision was harmful to the vital interest of Republika Srpska, and the RS National Assembly confirmed this on 7 July.
Cvijanović je tvrdila da je to pitanje vanjske politike, jer dva člana Komisije predlaže UNESCO.
Cvijanović claimed it was a foreign policy question, because UNESCO proposes two members of the Commission.
Sud je rekao da je imenovanje Komisije kadrovska odluka o domaćoj instituciji, a ne vanjska politika.
The court said the appointment of the Commission is a personnel decision about a domestic institution, not foreign policy.
Komisija se finansira iz državnog budžeta, a svih 5 članova imenuje Predsjedništvo.
The Commission is funded from the state budget, and the Presidency appoints all 5 members.
Sud je dodao da član Predsjedništva ne može staviti veto na svaku odluku, nego samo na neka pitanja.
The court added that a Presidency member cannot veto every decision, but only certain questions.
Zato imenovanje članova Komisije ostaje na snazi.
That is why the appointment of the Commission's members remains in force.

title: Sud u Sarajevu raspisao potjernicu za dvojicom muškaraca
Sarajevo court issues a warrant for two men
body: Kantonalni sud u Sarajevu raspisao je potjernicu za Tarikom Panjetom i Davudom Puškićem.
The Cantonal Court in Sarajevo has issued a warrant for Tarik Panjeta and Davud Puškić.
Potjernica je nalog policiji da traži i uhapsi osobu.
A warrant is an order to the police to search for and arrest a person.
Glasnogovornik suda Jakov Avram rekao je da se sumnjiče za razbojništvo.
Court spokesman Jakov Avram said they are suspected of robbery.
Slučaj je povezan s akcijom "Pirat", koju je policija prošle sedmice provela u Sarajevu.
The case is linked to the operation "Pirat", which the police carried out in Sarajevo last week.
Policija je tada u jednom stanu kod Narodnog pozorišta uhapsila mladića rođenog 1998. godine.
The police then arrested a young man born in 1998 in a flat near the National Theatre.
U istoj akciji uhapšena su još dvojica muškaraca, rođena 2004. i 1998. godine.
In the same operation two more men were arrested, born in 2004 and 1998.
Panjeta i Puškić bježe od policije već nekoliko dana.
Panjeta and Puškić have been running from the police for several days.
Puškić je u augustu bio u pritvoru mjesec dana zbog pucnjave u jednom lokalu na Baščaršiji.
In August Puškić was in custody for a month because of a shooting in a bar in Baščaršija.
Protiv Panjete je 2021. godine potvrđena optužnica zbog prodaje droge.
In 2021 an indictment against Panjeta was confirmed for selling drugs.
Bio je optužen i zbog toga što je nezakonito imao oružje.
He was also charged because he illegally had a weapon.

title: Šapić ostaje gradonačelnik Beograda, smjena nije uspjela
Šapić stays mayor of Belgrade, removal fails
body: Aleksandar Šapić ostaje gradonačelnik Beograda, jer opozicija nije imala dovoljno glasova za smjenu.
Aleksandar Šapić remains mayor of Belgrade, because the opposition did not have enough votes to remove him.
U Skupštini grada za smjenu je glasalo 34 odbornika.
In the City Assembly 34 councillors voted for his removal.
Bilo je potrebno najmanje 56 glasova od ukupno 110.
At least 56 votes out of 110 in total were needed.
Glasanje je bilo tajno, a jedan odbornik glasao je protiv smjene.
The vote was secret, and one councillor voted against the removal.
Smjenu je pokrenuo pokret "Kreni-promeni" nakon incidenta 28. septembra.
The movement "Kreni-promeni" started the removal after an incident on 28 September.
Šapić je optužen da je tada napao odbornicu Tatjanu Mićić i slomio joj nos.
Šapić is accused of attacking councillor Tatjana Mićić and breaking her nose at that time.
Vlast tvrdi da za to nema dokaza.
The ruling parties claim there is no evidence for this.
Tužilaštvo je prošle sedmice tražilo da Šapić dobije najmanje 3 godine zatvora.
Last week the prosecution asked that Šapić get at least 3 years in prison.
Aleksandar Mirković iz vladajuće grupe rekao je da će Šapić na sudu dokazati da je nevin.
Aleksandar Mirković from the ruling group said that Šapić will prove in court that he is innocent.
Ovo je bio drugi pokušaj smjene, jer sjednica 13. oktobra nije održana.
This was the second attempt at removal, because the session on 13 October was not held.
Tada vladajući odbornici nisu došli, pa nije bilo kvoruma.
At that time the ruling councillors did not come, so there was no quorum.

title: Nova Skupština SBK počela s radom, Matišić ponovo predsjedavajući
New Central Bosnia Assembly starts work, Matišić chairman again
body: Skupština Srednjobosanskog kantona konstituisana je u ponedjeljak u Travniku.
The Assembly of Central Bosnia Canton was constituted on Monday in Travnik.
Dražen Matišić iz HDZ-a BiH ponovo je izabran za predsjedavajućeg, i to na 4 godine.
Dražen Matišić of HDZ BiH was again elected chairman, for 4 years.
Njegovi zamjenici su Salkan Merdžanić iz SDA i Zorana Kunovac iz SDP-a.
His deputies are Salkan Merdžanić of the SDA and Zorana Kunovac of the SDP.
Predsjednik CIK-a Jovan Kalaba predao je uvjerenja za 30 zastupnika, koji su zatim položili zakletvu.
The president of the Central Election Commission, Jovan Kalaba, handed certificates to 30 MPs, who then took the oath.
Četiri zastupnika su zamrznula mandate, pa su na njihova mjesta došla nova imena.
Four MPs froze their mandates, so new names took their places.
Za izbor nove vlade kantona potrebno je 20 glasova, odnosno dvije trećine.
Electing a new cantonal government requires 20 votes, that is two thirds.
SDA ima 11 zastupnika, a koalicija oko HDZ-a BiH ima 8, što je ukupno 19.
The SDA has 11 MPs and the coalition around HDZ BiH has 8, which is 19 in total.
To znači da im za vladu nedostaje jedan glas.
That means they are one vote short for a government.
Matišić je rekao da Skupština treba biti mjesto poštovanja i korektnog političkog dijaloga.
Matišić said the Assembly should be a place of respect and proper political dialogue.
Sjednica će se nastaviti kada CIK potvrdi liste delegata za Dom naroda FBiH.
The session will continue when the Central Election Commission confirms the lists of delegates for the FBiH House of Peoples.

title: Trump tražio od Nvidije da Huanga vrati na čelo
Trump asked Nvidia to bring Huang back to the top
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump uključio se telefonom u sjednicu odbora direktora Nvidije.
US President Donald Trump joined a meeting of Nvidia's board of directors by phone.
Prema portalu Semafor, tražio je da Jensen Huang ponovo postane direktor kompanije.
According to the Semafor portal, he asked that Jensen Huang become the company's director again.
Nekoliko sati kasnije odbor je jednoglasno vratio Huanga na mjesto predsjednika i direktora.
A few hours later the board unanimously returned Huang to the position of president and director.
Huang je otišao 12. novembra, nakon što su otkrivene njegove vanbračne veze.
Huang left on 12 November, after his extramarital affairs were revealed.
Jedna od tih žena je osumnjičena da je kineska špijunka.
One of those women is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
Odbor je sada rekao da je od najvišeg nivoa vlasti u SAD-u dobio garanciju da Huang nije opasnost za nacionalnu sigurnost.
The board now said it had received a guarantee from the highest level of the US government that Huang is not a danger to national security.
Nakon vijesti su dionice Nvidije porasle za oko 30 posto.
After the news, Nvidia's shares rose by about 30 percent.
Trump je na mreži Truth Social napisao da je odluka ispravna i da Huanga lično poznaje.
Trump wrote on the Truth Social network that the decision was right and that he knows Huang personally.
Rekao je da vlada nema dokaza da je Huang uradio nešto nezakonito.
He said the government has no evidence that Huang did anything illegal.
Ipak je pozvao kompaniju da nastavi istragu o poštivanju pravila za izvoz.
Still, he called on the company to continue the investigation into compliance with export rules.
Predsjednik odbora je još 17. novembra rekao da Huang neće biti vraćen.
As late as 17 November the board chairman had said Huang would not be brought back.

title: Bakić se smiješi kameri, a Vučić ga mrko gleda
Bakić smiles at the camera, while Vučić glares at him
body: U Skupštini Srbije u ponedjeljak su održane konsultacije kod predsjednika Skupštine Aleksandra Čupića.
Consultations with the Speaker of the Assembly, Aleksandar Čupić, were held in the Serbian Assembly on Monday.
Jedan do drugog sjedili su Jovo Bakić iz Studentske liste i Aleksandar Vučić.
Jovo Bakić from the Student List and Aleksandar Vučić sat next to each other.
Na snimku se vidi kako se Bakić smiješi i maše kameri, a Vučić ga ozbiljno gleda.
The video shows Bakić smiling and waving at the camera, while Vučić looks at him seriously.
Snimak je objavljen na YouTube kanalu Skupštine Srbije.
The video was published on the Serbian Assembly's YouTube channel.
Razgovaralo se o izboru članova skupštinskih odbora i delegacija u međunarodnim institucijama.
They talked about choosing members of assembly committees and delegations to international institutions.
Bakić je došao sa zastupnikom Mariom Reljanovićem, a Vučić sa svojim zamjenikom Milenkom Jovanovim.
Bakić came with MP Mario Reljanović, and Vučić with his deputy Milenko Jovanov.
Nakon sastanka Vučić je rekao da njegovi zastupnici vjerovatno neće raditi u odborima.
After the meeting Vučić said that his MPs will probably not work in the committees.
Konačna odluka bit će donesena sutra, kada se nastavlja konstitutivna sjednica.
The final decision will be made tomorrow, when the constitutive session continues.
Bakić je profesor na Filozofskom fakultetu u Beogradu i već godinama kritikuje Vučićevu vlast.
Bakić is a professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade and has criticised Vučić's government for years.
Njih dvojica su se u tri dana sjednice više puta oštro svađali.
The two of them argued sharply several times during the three days of the session.

title: Kina spremna za let koji vodi prvog stranca na svoju stanicu
China ready for a flight taking the first foreigner to its station
body: Kina je završila pripreme za lansiranje svemirske letjelice Shenzhou-24.
China has finished preparations for the launch of the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft.
Prema kineskoj televiziji CCTV, spremna je i svemirska stanica Tiangong.
According to Chinese television CCTV, the Tiangong space station is also ready.
Na ovaj let ide i prvi strani astronaut, koji dolazi iz Pakistana.
The first foreign astronaut, who comes from Pakistan, is also going on this flight.
Letjelica i raketa prošle sedmice su prebačene na lansirno mjesto u centru Jiuquan na sjeverozapadu Kine.
The spacecraft and rocket were moved last week to the launch site at the Jiuquan centre in north-west China.
U subotu je održana generalna proba svih sistema, ali datum lansiranja još nije objavljen.
A full rehearsal of all systems was held on Saturday, but the launch date has not been announced yet.
Pakistanski astronaut će kratko ostati u orbiti i vratit će se na Zemlju letjelicom Shenzhou-23.
The Pakistani astronaut will stay in orbit for a short time and will return to Earth on the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft.
To će biti prvi zajednički let kineskih i stranih astronauta u kineskom programu.
It will be the first joint flight of Chinese and foreign astronauts in the Chinese programme.
Posada koja je sada na stanici pripremila je prostor, zalihe i mjesta za spavanje.
